_comment: Pins both halves of RFC-MACP-0007 Section 2's initiator rule when the initiator is NOT a declared participant: it cannot propose, and it can still commit. Every other Decision fixture with a non-empty roster lists the initiator in participants, so neither half was observable; decision_zero_participants.json covers only the empty roster.
description: Decision Mode: an initiator outside the participant list cannot propose but remains the default Commitment authority.

messages._comment: RFC-MACP-0007 Section 2: the initiator MUST be in participants if it intends to emit Proposal, and here it is not. Proposal is authorized only for declared participants (Section 2.1), so this is FORBIDDEN.

THE DISCRIMINATOR. RFC-MACP-0007 Section 2: the initiator is the default Commitment authority regardless of participant-list membership. No policy is bound, so the face-value exception applies (Section 6.2).
